answer: A cryptographic stake-weighted reputation protocol, resembling an anchored jetty holding fast against incoming tides, secures an economy of AI agents against Sybil attacks. Each agent must lock collateral within a designated verification grove to participate in governance consensus. If a malicious entity spawns numerous fake identities, the capital expenditure required to provision each node drains their resources into a frozen liquidation lagoon, making mass replication economically prohibitive.
